name: Alta Villa
address: Alta Villa, Broadleas Commons, Ballymore Eustace, Co. Kildare
agent: John O'Reilly, Sherry FitzGerald O'Reilly, Naas
questions: Could the 3.15 × 2.8 m study take a double bed for older parents, and could a shower go into the ground-floor bathroom beside it (it has a bath only)? Alternatively, could the 8.1 × 4.05 m playroom become a bedroom, given that its stairs are the only way up to the two loft rooms?
The services aren't stated. Is the house on mains water or a private well, and is drainage to a septic tank? If septic, how old is it, where is it, and is it registered?

Can you send the folio map for the 0.65 acre? How far are the houses beyond the rear lawn, who owns the hedgerow boundary, and is it dog-proof all round? BuyerIQ shows a mapped flood zone about 0.2 km away: has the site or the lane ever flooded?
Do the two loft rooms in the 1988 extension have planning and building-regulation sign-off as habitable rooms, with a fire escape route? How old is the oil boiler, and has a radon test been done?
We'd hope to see it at the open viewing on Saturday 14 Nov, 12:00–12:15. Could we also have a longer private viewing, and is the NBI fibre line already connected?

ai.why: The charm is real: an early-1800s stone house with 0.7 m walls, a slate roof, an Aga under a beamed, vaulted kitchen and old fireplaces, about 220 m² on 0.65 ac, 15–18 minutes from Naas and its adults' ED and about 20 minutes from Sallins' trains. Held back by only two small bathrooms for six, a small ground-floor study as the parents' room (bath, no shower), through-room access to the playroom and loft rooms, houses within about 25–100 m on one side, BER D and €530k.

electricity.detail: Likely mains; not stated, but a lived-in house with an alarm and all appliances included.

water.detail: Unknown; not stated in the Daft or MyHome listing. Rural site about 1.2 km south of the village, so ask whether it's mains or a well.

sewer.detail: Likely septic; not stated, rural site outside the village. Ask its age, location and registration.

internet.detail: Likely fibre; NBI lists Ballymore Eustace in its Blessington deployment area, and BuyerIQ's summary says '389 Mb full fibre' but its broadband panel shows no data. Not stated in the listing.

groundFloorBedroom.detail: No bedroom downstairs: the 3.15 × 2.8 m study sits beside the family bathroom (bath, WC, no shower), and the 8.1 × 4.05 m dual-aspect playroom has a washroom plumbed for a WC but is reached through the utility and holds the only stairs to the loft rooms.

bedsNote: Three double bedrooms upstairs, plus two loft rooms (6.1 × 4.05 m and 3.35 × 3.35 m) over the 1988 extension, a ground-floor study and an 8.1 × 4.05 m playroom
heating: Oil-fired central heating, a classic Aga in the kitchen, an electric stove in the dining-room brick fireplace and a cast-iron fireplace in the living room
tagline: An early-1800s stone house, extended in 1988, with about 220 m² on 0.65 acre at Broadleas Commons, about 1.2 km south of Ballymore Eustace village in west Kildare.

pros.detail: Shown on the 1838 OS map; 0.7 m stone walls and a slate roof, a classic Aga in a red-brick surround under a vaulted, beamed kitchen, cast-iron and red-brick fireplaces, a built-in dresser and maple floors.

pros.text: About 220 m² with generous common rooms
pros.detail: A triple-aspect 8.55 × 3.7 m kitchen/dining room, a 5.35 × 2.9 m family room with a wall of windows to the garden, an 8.1 × 4.05 m playroom, a dining room, a living room and a 3.6 × 3.35 m utility.

pros.text: Naas and its adults' ED 15–18 minutes
pros.detail: Naas General's 24-hour ED (16+) is about 11 km in a straight line and Naas town about 13 km per the listing; the village, with a pharmacy, shop and pubs, is about 1.2 km north.

pros.text: Frequent Dublin trains about 20 minutes away
pros.detail: Sallins & Naas station is about 14 km in a straight line, with about 25 weekday commuter departures towards Heuston and Grand Canal Dock (NTA data, Nov 2026).

pros.text: 0.65 acre with a gated courtyard and a big rear lawn
pros.detail: A gated south-east-facing cobblelock courtyard, stone raised beds, a gravel drive for many cars, a patio off the family room, a rear lawn with a natural hedgerow boundary and two block-built sheds.
Cross and Passion College, Kilcullen (mixed) sent 82% to third level in the 2025 Irish Times feeder table; Blessington Community College (mixed) is 7.4 km.

cons.text: Only two small bathrooms for six
cons.detail: A 2.35 × 1.85 m ground-floor bathroom with a bath but no shower and a 1.85 × 1.7 m shower room upstairs; no en-suites. The playroom washroom has a basin and is plumbed for a WC only.
The parents' room would be the 3.15 × 2.8 m (8.8 m²) study by the bath-only bathroom, or the 33 m² playroom, which is reached through the utility and holds the stairs to the loft rooms.

cons.text: Awkward through-room layout and level changes
cons.detail: The floor plan shows steps down into the family room and up into the kitchen; the loft rooms are reached only through the playroom, and Loft Room 2 only through Loft Room 1.

OpenStreetMap shows about eight houses within 100 m, the nearest about 25–45 m south-west, and the rear-lawn photo shows a row of houses at the far end; open fields lie on the other sides. Not checked on satellite imagery.

cons.text: BER D2 and an old house to heat
cons.detail: 263.95 kWh/m²/yr on oil, with uPVC windows from 2012; stone walls and a 1988 extension suggest a rough €40–80k retrofit for a B rating (rough estimate).
About €2,409/m², stamp duty €5,300. Water and drainage aren't stated, and BuyerIQ shows a mapped flood zone about 0.2 km away.
Scoil Mhuire turned away up to 16 junior-infant applicants in 2024 (one class of 26), so places for two boys aren't certain.
